g.text: Title: USB-C power meter, rev D (4-48 V, 5 A)

g.desc: Title: USB-C power meter, rev D (4-48 V, 5 A)

g.text: Pass-through USB-C plug -> receptacle, INA228 + STM32G0B1 USB CDC to the PC

g.desc: Pass-through USB-C plug -> receptacle, INA228 + STM32G0B1 USB CDC to the PC

g.text: CC1/CC2/D+/D- are read through 1M/1M dividers (PD/QC state, ~2 Mohm load). SuperSpeed pairs are not passed (USB 2.0 data only).

g.desc: CC1/CC2/D+/D- are read through 1M/1M dividers (PD/QC state, ~2 Mohm load). SuperSpeed pairs are not passed (USB 2.0 data only).

g.text: J3 to the PC: 5 V -> U3 -> 3V3 for U1/U2 only, never for the device under test. U2 is a USB CDC device; blank chips start the ST USB DFU bootloader.

g.desc: J3 to the PC: 5 V -> U3 -> 3V3 for U1/U2 only, never for the device under test. U2 is a USB CDC device; blank chips start the ST USB DFU bootloader.

g.text: Rev D: in-line USB-C tester. J1 (plug) goes into the charger, the device cable goes into J2. Every USB 2.0 line passes straight through.

g.desc: Rev D: in-line USB-C tester. J1 (plug) goes into the charger, the device cable goes into J2. Every USB 2.0 line passes straight through.

g.text: Current: 10 mOhm high-side shunt R1, INA228 ADCRANGE 1 (+-4.096 A, 7.8 uA/LSB) or 0 (+-16 A, 31 uA/LSB). 4-48 V (PD 3.1 EPR), 5 A max.

g.desc: Current: 10 mOhm high-side shunt R1, INA228 ADCRANGE 1 (+-4.096 A, 7.8 uA/LSB) or 0 (+-16 A, 31 uA/LSB). 4-48 V (PD 3.1 EPR), 5 A max.

g.text: Connector voltage ratings: J1 DX07 20 Vrms / 1.25 A per power pin (5 A total). Above 20 V the electronics are fine, the connectors run outside their rating.
